# The Pharmaceutical Journal

> The official journal of the Royal Pharmaceutical Society providing evidence-based pharmacy practice guidance, clinical news, and professional development for UK pharmacists.

The Pharmaceutical Journal is the peer-reviewed publication of the Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS), covering contemporary pharmacy practice, NHS policy, medicines safety, and healthcare regulation in the UK. It serves as a primary resource for pharmacists, technicians, and healthcare professionals seeking continuing professional development and clinical guidance.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy practice
- NHS policy
- GLP-1 inhibitors
- Medicines safety
- Patient safety
- Professional development
- Healthcare policy
- Pharmacy funding
- Community pharmacy
- Prescribing guidance
- Pharmacy First program
- NICE guidance
- Pharmacogenomics
- Vaccination services
- Smoking cessation
